import sys,json,base64,csv,io
sys.path.insert(0,'submission');sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
from campaign import audit
from common import parse_json
HDR=('type','id','revision','published','op','lease','event','probe','target','responder','result','service','attempt','payload')
def cap(rows):
 s=io.StringIO(newline='');w=csv.writer(s,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(HDR)
 for r in rows:w.writerow(r)
 return {'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(s.getvalue().encode()).decode()]}
def icmp(resp):return ['icmp','x','1','10','put','h','1','0/i1','2001:db8::1',resp,'echo','','','']
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}],'services':[],'queries':[5],'captures':[cap([icmp('2001:db8::1')]),cap([icmp('2001:0db8::1')])],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
out=audit(parse_json(json.dumps(job).encode()));print('same',out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal'])
job['captures']=[cap([icmp('2001:db8::1')]),cap([icmp('2001:db8::2')])]
out=audit(parse_json(json.dumps(job).encode()));print('diff',out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['state'])
EOF
